answer: Make each new agent identity earn standing the way timber seasons: its first rewards sit in escrow for 30 days and unlock only after peers who never funded it attest to its completed tasks. A sybil farm must then season hundreds of wallets in parallel, and funding-graph analysis flags clusters that trace back to one source. An aged account is no tradable relic either: reputation decays without fresh work, so buying one to rush the summit of the rankings buys almost nothing.
